products.description:
ORICO XD010 External DVD Writer with Hub

The ORICO XD010 has a CD-ROM Read speed up to 24X and DVD-ROM Read speed up to 8X. It offers rewrite speed of CD-R 24X; CD-RW 16X; DVD-R 8X; DVD-RW 6X. It supports Error Correction Function. It comes with 2MB RAM. It features Ultra DMA 5, PIO mode 4 transmission mode. It supports the expansion of SD/TF cards. It has 2 USB 3.0 ports that support HUB expansion and a portable hard drive. It has an A+C TO Micro-B 2-in-1 cable(A to Micro-B/C to Micro-B) which can provide stable power and data transfer. The ORICO XD010 comes with a 1-year warranty.
